objective: 冻结R61全局max/min并发修正公式，在生产Mooncake RDMA上测量Phase60从未测过的reserved payload pair与fresh endpoint placement，机械验证P1D2/P2D1两流通信时间是否达到整体10%、各配置拓扑15%的fresh-blind精度合同。
execution_model: external fresh topology inventory; 24 auditable three-rank GPU shards; frozen-model CPU aggregation with no fitting

research_scope.wave_admission: all three ranks and both transfers are ready before synchronized release
research_scope.decision_scope: none; P/D counts, routing, payload and placement are frozen inputs

frozen_correction_contract.formula: max(1.0, intercept_us + beta_max * max(C0,C1) + beta_min * min(C0,C1))
frozen_correction_contract.runtime_inputs: C0/C1 are frozen Phase51 official P1D1 curve interpolations for the two payloads
forbidden: using matched-solo or blind target as an inference input

blind_payload_contract.opening_policy: definitions were predeclared in Phase60; GPU measurements and targets are first opened only after R61 froze the correction

topology_definitions.L1: one physical node, three launched GPU ranks per shard
topology_definitions.L2: two physical nodes in one rack/network domain, three launched GPU ranks per shard
topology_definitions.L3: two physical nodes in different racks but one RDMA domain, three launched GPU ranks per shard

resource_allocation_contract.endpoint_slots: A0/A1/B0/B1 are four GPU slots, not four nodes
resource_allocation_contract.scheduling: all topology/configuration/replica shards may run sequentially; four-node simultaneous allocation is never required

fresh_placement_contract.every_phase62_endpoint_tuple_fresh: every (host, physical_gpu, ib_device) tuple must be absent from all Phase60 measurement ranks
fresh_placement_contract.replicas_distinct: the two Phase62 endpoint signatures within each topology must differ
fresh_placement_contract.host_signature_definition: sorted physical host set used by one placement; one host for L1 and two hosts for L2/L3
fresh_placement_contract.selection_source: scheduler/asset host, rack and fabric metadata only; never benchmark speed, Phase61 error or observed latency
fresh_placement_contract.claim_boundary: fresh endpoint placement is mandatory; at least one of two placements per topology also has a host signature unseen in Phase60

transport_contract.concurrent_call_policy: reuse the pinned Phase60 production benchmark: P1D2 has one shared engine with two worker threads; P2D1 has one sender engine per P rank

measurement_contract.wave_latency_semantic: maximum sender-side synchronous call latency across the two concurrently admitted flows
measurement_contract.data_validation: outside timed intervals verify every destination byte after each mode
measurement_contract.official_point_policy: median across repeats inside each replica, then maximum actual concurrent latency across the two pre-frozen fresh replicas
measurement_contract.raw_storage: all JSONL and per-iteration samples remain outside Git

fresh_blind_acceptance_gate.selection: mechanical evaluation only; failure is retained honestly and never triggers refit on blind labels

container_contract.required_gpu_class: CUDA GPU with GPUDirect RDMA; NVIDIA A51 B200 is acceptable

claim_boundary: Phase62 is fresh-blind physical validation of the frozen R61 correction for exactly two flows in P1D2/P2D1
a PASS supports reserved payload and fresh endpoint-placement generalization across the measured two models and L1/L2/L3
it does not support P2D2, more flows, end-to-end serving, compute, memory, queueing, unrelated-job congestion, online arrivals or scheduling
stop_and_block_if: HEAD is not exact W62 or any pinned input differs
any Phase60 development payload is measured or any R61 coefficient/threshold is changed
topology inventory is not frozen before raw, reuses a Phase60 endpoint tuple, or lacks one unseen host signature per topology
an executor requests more than two simultaneous nodes for one shard
production Mooncake RDMA/dma-buf is unavailable or falls back to TCP, MNNVL, NVLink bypass, staging or custom pool
model weights, inference, training, downloads, protected raw/cache/PID assets are accessed
raw would enter Git or an existing Phase62 result directory would be overwritten
